name: XHAND 1
summary: XHAND 1 is Robotera's five-finger hand designed for AI research and robotic manipulation. Its 12 active degrees of freedom are distributed as three each in the thumb and index finger and two in each remaining finger. Motors and gears provide independent joint control, including index-finger lateral movement. Optional high-resolution tactile sensors provide three-dimensional contact-force and temperature information. The official brochure lists a 1.1 kg mass, Linux SDK and ROS-compatible applications, together with glove and visual-mapping teleoperation support for testing and training-data col

description.en: XHAND 1 is Robotera's five-finger hand designed for AI research and robotic manipulation. Its 12 active degrees of freedom are distributed as three each in the thumb and index finger and two in each remaining finger. Motors and gears provide independent joint control, including index-finger lateral movement. Optional high-resolution tactile sensors provide three-dimensional contact-force and temperature information. The official brochure lists a 1.1 kg mass, Linux SDK and ROS-compatible applications, together with glove and visual-mapping teleoperation support for testing and training-data collection.
description.zh: 星动纪元五指灵巧手，具有12个主动自由度。官方手册列明自重1.1千克、手指关节独立驱动，可配置高分辨率触觉传感器。
